keyPoints.en: he – one boy/man; she – one girl/woman; it – one thing or animal
keyPoints.hi: he – एक लड़का/आदमी; she – एक लड़की/औरत; it – एक चीज़ या जानवर

keyPoints.en: they – more than one person or thing
keyPoints.hi: they – एक से ज़्यादा लोग या चीज़ें

keyPoints.en: I and we – when you talk about yourself
keyPoints.hi: I और we – जब अपने बारे में बोलो

problem.en: Replace the underlined noun: "Grandma tells stories. Grandma is kind."
problem.hi: संज्ञा बदलो: "Grandma tells stories. Grandma is kind."

answer.en: Grandma tells stories. She is kind.
answer.hi: Grandma tells stories. She is kind.

steps.en: Puppies are more than one → they.

intro.en: A pronoun is used in place of a noun: I, you, he, she, it, we, they. Using pronouns stops us repeating the same noun again and again.
intro.hi: सर्वनाम (pronoun) संज्ञा की जगह इस्तेमाल होता है: I, you, he, she, it, we, they। इससे एक ही संज्ञा बार-बार नहीं दोहरानी पड़ती।
